answer: If rewards are escrowed until a wilderness voyage challenge, how can agents prevent bulk farms? Each identity must prove ownership of a unique grove via real-time photo verification, cross-referenced against mapped meadow grids. Attackers must stage physical setups per identity—costs scale linearly in time and space, as drone farms can’t simultaneouslRo FIELD-attest identities. Escrowed funds penalize failures, burning both grove bonds and voyage fuel deposits.
